T005 : ∀ (n m : ℕ) (u : WM.X n × ℝ → WM.Y m) (q : WM.Y m),
  WM.supportAndRegularity u q →
    ∀ (t : ℝ),
      0 < t →
        ∃ C R B,
          WM.localData u q t C R ∧ 0 ≤ B ∧ ∀ x ∈ WM.box n R, ∀ r ∈ Set.Icc (t - t / 4) (t + t / 4), |WM.et u (x, r)| ≤ B
'Translation.T005' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
